name: CRUCIBLE Aurum Veritas Artisan Full Arm
product_name: Crucible Aurum Veritas Commission Arm — Bespoke Artisan Series
description:
The Crucible Aurum Veritas is a hand-built, fully bespoke full-arm replacement commissioned as a single unique unit — no two are identical in design, surface treatment, or configuration. Each arm is constructed over 8–14 weeks by a named Crucible artisan using a titanium-core chassis finished in hand-engraved 22-karat gold-plated paneling, with gem inlay options, custom synthetic skin panels, and client-specified ergonomic calibration built from a full physiological profile. The mechanical internals meet or exceed Chromeworks-tier neural integration standards, but the distinguishing feature is the exterior: a wearable objet d'art that functions as a fully capable prosthetic limb.

The Aurum Veritas is purchased almost exclusively by Tier 5 Spire residents for whom a cyberlimb is as much a declaration of identity and wealth as a functional replacement. Crucible maintains a waitlist of 18–30 months and refuses to rush commissions, which has only increased the arm's cachet. At Spire galas, identifying a fellow Aurum owner across the room is considered a social icebreaker of considerable weight.
installation_requirements: Full shoulder disarticulation, Crucible partner surgical suite, mandatory 3-day physiological profiling prior to fabrication, Spire-tier medical facility recommended
rejection_risk: Minimal – each unit is custom-calibrated to client physiology during fabrication; biocompatibility profiling reduces rejection incidence to under 1%
maintenance: Annual artisan servicing by commissioning Crucible craftsperson only, surface refinishing available as paid service, proprietary neural calibration updates

Owners report significant anxiety around physical activities that risk surface damage to the engraving or gem inlay
The social visibility of the arm attracts attention — some of it unwanted, from people who know exactly what it costs
Neural calibration is so personalized that any third-party servicing risks sensory drift requiring full recalibration
cultural_context: At Spire level, a Crucible Aurum Veritas is not a medical device — it is a commission, a statement, and a relationship with an artisan. Crucible maintains records of every arm they have ever built, and the secondary market for authenticated Aurum units belonging to deceased Spire luminaries has produced auction prices exceeding original commission costs by several multiples.

Celebrity figures and public personalities in GLMZ's upper cultural sphere

Spire-tier heirs receiving commissions as coming-of-age gifts
story_hooks: A Crucible artisan has gone missing mid-commission on an Aurum arm for one of the Spire's most powerful figures — the client is not asking nicely for an explanation
An authenticated Aurum Veritas has appeared on the black market, reportedly belonging to a Spire resident who is officially still alive and publicly wearing it — someone is lying
A Crucible commission ledger has been stolen, revealing which Spire figures have bespoke arms and therefore exactly how to identify them in disguise — the list is worth a fortune to the right buyer
